name: vaultivo
description: Search and read the documents archived in your company's Vaultivo account.

interface.longDescription: Vaultivo is a document archive for Austrian and EU businesses. Connect your Vaultivo account to search your archived documents (invoices, receipts, delivery notes, credit notes, contracts and more), read their extracted text, see what is still waiting in your Inbox, and find gaps such as a missing invoice number. The connection is read-only: it acts as you, sees only what your account may see, and never changes, deletes or approves anything.
defaultPrompt: Find last month's invoices from my suppliers in Vaultivo.
What is still open in my Vaultivo Inbox?
Are any outgoing invoice numbers missing in Vaultivo?
